correctness.rationale: PASS. The affine integral unimodular transform z+U preserves the full lattice, gcd of integer differences, and diameter-graph adjacency; reduce to axis box with lengths t a_i. The lattice diameter is L=t max a_i by the coordinate bound g<=max |delta_i| and a maximal coordinate edge achieving g=L. To have gcd L, every short coordinate difference vanishes and each maximum-length coordinate difference belongs to {0,±L}, nonzero somewhere. Fix shorter coordinates, interior values in long coordinates and the subset J of endpoint coordinates; every endpoint assignment on J is adjacent to every other and no edge leaves the clique K_{2^{|J|}}. Choosing J and the frozen values gives N_s=B binom(k,s)(L-1)^{k-s}, including L=1 and 0^0=1. Summing choose(2^s,2) gives B/2[(L+3)^k-(L+1)^k] and direct leading term k prod_i(a_i)/a times t^{d-1}; the chromatic polynomial and Borsuk number 2^k follow exactly from these disjoint cliques. Distinct diameter edges cannot be collinear with three binary-corner vertices, so segments equal maximal-diameter lines. Independently enumerated all integer-point pairs and gcds for seven boxes, including dimensions 1..3 with tied/untied sides, and reproduced full clique multiplicities and edge numbers. Unlimited d and t come from the coordinatewise proof, not finite enumeration.
residual_risks: Only unimodular integral affine boxes, not general rational or skew nonunimodular parallelotopes.
The general clique property and 2^d universal upper bound are prior work, not novel subclaims.
